Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting the annual parental declaration of intent to home school from the public disclosure act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting the annual parental declaration ofintent to home school from the public disclosure act; and amending RCW42.56.320.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.56.320 and 2005 c 274 s 412 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following educational information is exempt from disclosureunder this chapter: (1) Financial disclosures filed by private vocational schools underchapters 28B.85 and 28C.10 RCW; (2) Financial and commercial information supplied by or on behalfof a person, firm, corporation, or entity under chapter 28B.95 RCWrelating to the purchase or sale of tuition units and contracts for thepurchase of multiple tuition units; (3) Individually identifiable information received by the workforcetraining and education coordinating board for research or evaluationpurposes; ((and)) (4) Except for public records as defined in RCW ((40.14.040))40.14.010, any records or documents obtained by a state college, p. 1 HB 1288university, library, or archive through or concerning any gift, grant,conveyance, bequest, or devise, the terms of which restrict or regulatepublic access to those records or documents; and (5) The annual declaration of intent filed by parents under RCW28A.200.010 for a child to receive homebased instruction.
